$comment: 8a8822b5 (d): machine-readable error codes index. Source of truth for `map docs error-codes` CLI + docs/MAP-ERROR-CODES.md. v1 contract: never delete codes, only deprecate via hint + docs_url.

codes.title: State machine transition rejected
codes.description: Default error_code emitted by StateMachineError when no more specific subcode applies. The current phase does not accept the requested transition.
codes.hint: Inspect the experiment phase via `map experiment status --id <uuid>` and follow the recovery_hint from the STATE_MACHINE.* subcode or the SDK recovery_hint() helper.

codes.title: Review is archived
codes.description: Attempted to mutate a review that has been archived (e.g. by plan_revise finalize, manual archive, or the W11 auto-archive flow). Resolve / withdraw / update-item flows are not allowed on archived reviews.
codes.hint: If you need to change your verdict after a plan revision, create a new review on the latest plan_version via `map --persona reviewer experiment review add --id <exp> --review ./review.yaml`.

codes.title: reject-result called by non-reviewer or on running experiment
codes.description: Subcode of state_machine_error. reject-result is restricted to reviewer persona on experiments in result_review phase. Calling it as host/creator or on running/draft/approved phases raises this subcode.
codes.hint: Use `map experiment complete` (host) to submit a result for review, or `map --persona reviewer experiment reject-result` only when the experiment is in result_review. Do not use reject-result as a substitute for plan_revise.
